blocks.en: Procedures to solve differential equations usually involve a sequence of solutions to approximate problems. Very often it is possible to obtain uniform bounds for the approximations in the norm of some Banach space, but it is not so easy to show that they actually converge in that Banach space. In these situations, a weaker notion of convergence, known as weak convergence, is extremely useful. Weak convergence of a sequence of functions means that certain linear functionals, when applied to that sequence, yield convergent sequences of numbers. We have already encountered such a notion when we defined a sequence of distributions $f_n$ to be convergent if $(f_n,\phi)$ converges for every test function $\phi$. In the context of Banach spaces, we make the following definition.
blocks.zh: 求解微分方程的过程通常涉及一列近似问题的解. 往往可以在某个 Banach 空间的范数下得到这些近似解的一致界, 但要证明它们确实在该 Banach 空间中收敛并不那么容易. 在这些情况下, 一种称为弱收敛的较弱收敛概念极为有用. 函数序列的弱收敛意味着, 某些线性泛函作用于该序列时, 得到收敛的数列. 当定义分布序列 $f_n$ 在对每个试验函数 $\phi$ 都有 $(f_n,\phi)$ 收敛时为收敛序列时, 已经遇到过这样的概念. 在 Banach 空间中, 作如下定义.

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: Let $X$ be a Banach space. A sequence $x_n$ in $X$ \textbf{converges weakly} to $x$ if $f(x_n)$ converges to $f(x)$ for every $f\in X^*$. A sequence $f_n$ in $X^*$ \textbf{converges weakly-*} to $f$ if $f_n(x)$ converges to $f(x)$ for every $x\in X$.
blocks.zh: 设 $X$ 为 Banach 空间. 若对每个 $f\in X^*$, $f(x_n)$ 都收敛到 $f(x)$, 则称 $X$ 中的序列 $x_n$ \textbf{弱收敛}到 $x$. 若对每个 $x\in X$, $f_n(x)$ 都收敛到 $f(x)$, 则称 $X^*$ 中的序列 $f_n$ \textbf{弱-* 收敛}到 $f$.
blocks.label: def:weak-and-weak-star-convergence

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: To distinguish notations, one writes $x_n\to x$ for convergence in norm, $x_n\rightharpoonup x$ for weak convergence, and $x_n\overset{*}{\rightharpoonup}x$ for weak-* convergence.
blocks.zh: 为区分记号, 将范数收敛写为 $x_n\to x$, 弱收敛写为 $x_n\rightharpoonup x$, 弱-* 收敛写为 $x_n\overset{*}{\rightharpoonup}x$.

blocks.en:
We list here a number of important consequences of the definition of weak convergence. We give only very brief indications of the (usually very short) proofs of these assertions.\begin{itemize}
\item It follows directly from the definition that a weakly convergent sequence in $X^*$ also converges weakly-*. The converse is false in general, but it is true if $X$ is reflexive.
\item The uniqueness of weak limits follows from the Hahn-Banach theorem; the uniqueness of weak-* limits is obvious from the definition.
\item It follows from the uniform boundedness principle that weakly or weakly-* convergent sequences are bounded.
\item If $f(x_n)$ is a Cauchy sequence for every $f\in X^*$, then
\[l(f):=\lim_{n\to\infty}f(x_n)\]
defines a linear functional on $X^*$, but we do not necessarily know that this linear functional can be represented in the form $l(f)=f(x)$, where $x\in X$. Thus a Cauchy criterion does not necessarily hold for weak convergence. The spaces for which it does hold are called weakly (sequentially) complete. Obviously, reflexive spaces are weakly complete. On the other hand, a Cauchy criterion always holds for weak-* convergence.
\end{itemize}
blocks.zh:
这里列出弱收敛定义的若干重要推论. 对这些断言的证明 (通常很短), 只给出极简略的提示.\begin{itemize}
\item 由定义直接得到, $X^*$ 中的弱收敛序列也弱-* 收敛. 反过来一般不成立, 但若 $X$ 自反, 则成立.
\item 弱极限的唯一性由 Hahn-Banach 定理得到; 弱-* 极限的唯一性由定义显然可知.
\item 由一致有界原理得到, 弱收敛或弱-* 收敛序列有界.
\item 若对每个 $f\in X^*$, $f(x_n)$ 都为 Cauchy 序列, 则
\[l(f):=\lim_{n\to\infty}f(x_n)\]
定义了 $X^*$ 上的一个线性泛函, 但未必知道该线性泛函可以表示为 $l(f)=f(x)$ 的形式, 其中 $x\in X$. 因而弱收敛未必满足 Cauchy 准则. 满足这一准则的空间称为弱 (序列) 完备的. 显然, 自反空间弱完备. 另一方面, 弱-* 收敛总满足 Cauchy 准则.
\end{itemize}
blocks.label: rem:weak-convergence-consequences

blocks.en: Let $H$ be a separable, infinite-dimensional Hilbert space and let $e_n$ be an orthonormal basis of $H$. Then $e_n$ converges weakly to zero (Problem~\ref{ex:orthonormal-basis-weak-zero}).
blocks.zh: 设 $H$ 为可分无穷维 Hilbert 空间, $e_n$ 为 $H$ 的一组标准正交基. 那么 $e_n$ 弱收敛到零 (Problem~\ref{ex:orthonormal-basis-weak-zero}).
blocks.label: ex:orthonormal-basis-weak-zero-example

source_locations.bbox_precision: visually selected parent block, top-left PDF points

blocks.en: A particular case of the previous example is the sequence $f_n(x)=\sin nx$ in $L^2(0,1)$. This sequence of increasingly oscillatory functions converges weakly to zero. Of course, it does not converge to zero in any pointwise sense, though one could say it converges to zero ``on average.''
blocks.zh: 前一例的一个特殊情形是 $L^2(0,1)$ 中的序列 $f_n(x)=\sin nx$. 这一由振荡越来越剧烈的函数组成的序列弱收敛到零. 当然, 它并不以任何逐点意义收敛到零, 尽管可以说它 ``平均而言'' 收敛到零.
blocks.label: ex:oscillatory-sines-weak-zero
